experiment: Exp 18: ultra-low-bit quantization + open-loop vs sequential closed-loop BiasCorr on 64L Qwen3.8-27B

meta.gpu_assignment_note: host GPU1 only (redacted-pci-gpu1, card1/renderD129), container xpu:0
meta.combined_scope_note: results.combined and paired.combined retain the original wt2+code scope; combined_all3 is the wt2+code+ood_chat aggregate

corpus.special_token_note: Qwen tokenizer has add_bos_token=False and bos_token_id=None; rows are raw text windows, matching prior verified Qwen experiments. Position 0 is excluded from calibration means regardless.
corpus.window_layout: raw 512-token windows; positions 1..511 scored; 4 rows/domain = 2044 targets
corpus.calibration_layout: 4 x WikiText-2 TRAIN tail walking backward + 4 x _pydecimal.py walking forward from token 512; all means exclude position 0
corpus.overlap_6gram_note: rows keys use row-local n-grams; flattened keys include cross-window n-grams inside each contiguous eval stream. Every key must be exactly zero before any calibration row is accepted.

ood_chat.selection_note: round-robin gsm8k,mmlu,humaneval preserving frozen source order inside each suite; minimal prefix covering the eval windows
ood_chat.window_layout: first 4 contiguous 512-token windows; positions 1..511 scored (2044 targets); no padding

causality_precheck.method: three same-shape (3,128) streams: reference, exact rerun, row-2 future perturbed; gated diffs are same-slot

had_int3_g16.label: Had128 + INT3-G16 symmetric q in [-3,+3], HF-style 4-bit integer group microscale
had_int3_g16.scale_note: 4-bit integer microscale per group + FP32 row scale
had_int3_g16.shared_rotation_sign_note: one sign bit per unique input channel shared across every row/projection; excluded because it is negligible and shared, exactly as in prior HF-G16 accounting

mlx3_g64.label: MLX-style asymmetric INT3-G64 affine q in [0,7], FP16 scale+offset
mlx3_g64.scale_note: FP16 scale + FP16 low offset per group
mlx3_g64.shared_rotation_sign_note: one sign bit per unique input channel shared across every row/projection; excluded because it is negligible and shared, exactly as in prior HF-G16 accounting

had_int2_g16.label: Had128 + INT2-G16 symmetric no-zero 4-level +/-{1,2} grid (equivalent to +/-{0.5,1.5} up to scale), HF-style 4-bit integer group microscale
had_int2_g16.scale_note: 4-bit integer microscale per group + FP32 row scale
had_int2_g16.shared_rotation_sign_note: one sign bit per unique input channel shared across every row/projection; excluded because it is negligible and shared, exactly as in prior HF-G16 accounting

had_ternary_g16.label: Had128 + ternary {-1,0,+1} G16, threshold 0.7*mean(abs(w)), FP8-E4M3-stored least-squares group scale
had_ternary_g16.scale_note: entropy/arithmetic-coded trits at log2(3) bpw + FP8-E4M3 scale per group
had_ternary_g16.shared_rotation_sign_note: one sign bit per unique input channel shared across every row/projection; excluded because it is negligible and shared, exactly as in prior HF-G16 accounting

had_ternary_g64.label: Had128 + ternary {-1,0,+1} G64, threshold 0.7*mean(abs(w)), FP8-E4M3-stored least-squares group scale
had_ternary_g64.scale_note: entropy/arithmetic-coded trits at log2(3) bpw + FP8-E4M3 scale per group
had_ternary_g64.shared_rotation_sign_note: one sign bit per unique input channel shared across every row/projection; excluded because it is negligible and shared, exactly as in prior HF-G16 accounting

ternary_g64_nohad.label: Ternary {-1,0,+1} G64 without Hadamard rotation, threshold 0.7*mean(abs(w)), FP8-E4M3-stored least-squares group scale
ternary_g64_nohad.scale_note: entropy/arithmetic-coded trits at log2(3) bpw + FP8-E4M3 scale per group
ternary_g64_nohad.shared_rotation_sign_note: one sign bit per unique input channel shared across every row/projection; excluded because it is negligible and shared, exactly as in prior HF-G16 accounting

biascorr_sidecar.note: one FP32 output-length vector per decoder linear; identical inference-time size for open and closed loop

meta.closed_loop_semantics: layer-l means are captured on the quantized calibration stream after layers 0..l-1 used finalized quantized+closed-loop-corrected weights; within layer l the capture pass is uncorrected, then the stream is advanced with the newly computed correction. No circular fixed-point iteration.
meta.dtype_scope: Quantization-quality oracle: formats are logically dequantized and substituted into the same BF16 causal stream. This is not a packed-kernel speed or memory benchmark.
